newsitem.title: INDIA: India SEBI suspends Reliance share transfer agent.
newsitem.headline: India SEBI suspends Reliance share transfer agent.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has decided to suspend the share transfer agent of Reliance Industries Ltd for six months, its chief said on Wednesday.

The licence of Reliance Consultancy Services (RCS), the sole share registrar and transfer agent for the Reliance group, will be suspended from February 1, 1997 to July 31, 1997, SEBI chairman D.R. Mehta told reporters.
He said RCS has been given time from October 17 to January 31, 1997 to make alternate arrangements for shareholders of the Reliance group.
The suspension follows an inquiry into improper share swaps by RCS, Mehta said.

"I'm convinced that RCS have failed to maintain records for transactions ....that RCS have not conducted their activities in a manner which is fair, diligent and with care, skill and with integrity," Mehta said.
